fields.Author: Misty Melendez
fields.EventDesc:
Student pup at Voyage Limited office for all students studying math, computer science, and music!

Make sure to include allergi information when signing up!

fields.Author: Vilma Noble
fields.EventDesc:
We at Voidcloud will be holding company lectures every monday in this december! This will be relevant for students studying economics and history.

Take this opportunity to become more educated! Some snacks will also be served!

fields.Author: Donte Meadows
fields.EventDesc:
Welcome to Delugation's annual sports event!

The event is split into 3 parts and takes place during the first 7 days of june, july, and august.

See you there!

fields.Author: Anthony Hull
fields.EventDesc:
Hello! We at Bulltechs would like to welcome some students for a study-visit. 

You will get the opportunity to visit our office and get some insight into how we work. Lunch is included for free.

fields.Author: Cecelia Warren
fields.EventDesc:
We will be having some christmas music in Aula Magna. Come and check it out!

Merry christmas!

fields.Author: Virgil Peterson
fields.EventDesc:
The annual KAU student hunting period!

Students try to survive while we hunt them. Good luck!

fields.Author: Håkan Löfvgrenstensson
fields.NewsDesc: Trädgårdsmästarna Karlstad kommer att lägga hålla i en studentpub snart! Håll utgick i events!
